snippet.title: Steak Simulator: Medium Rare | Steam Next Fest Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
As a steak, you must rediscover and navigate this bizarre world, overcome daunting challenges, and cook yourself to perfection to become a delectable delicacy.

Team up with your friends and dash into thrilling, high-speed steak races!

🥩 Wishlist Steak Simulator: Medium Rare now on Steam!
🎮 Play the demo during Steam Next Fest — October 2026!

Stay juicy. Stay tender. Don’t get overcooked.
